role: Manages ConversationContext node lifecycle and boundary detection for assertion processing.
detail: ConversationContextManager orchestrates creation, retrieval, closure, and boundary detection for ConversationContext INSTANCE nodes. Main entry point is resolve_context_for_assertion(session_id, turn_id, correlation_id) which detects boundaries (session_change, time_gap, topic_shift, initial) and returns ContextResolutionResult with context_node_id, is_new_context, boundary_type, prior_context_node_id. Boundaries are triggered by: (1) session_id change, (2) Jaccard similarity of recent/prior turn senses < threshold, (3) elapsed time > time_gap_minutes since last context update. Helper methods: _find_active_context (queries all CONVERSATION_CONTEXT nodes, filters by status ACTIVE and closed==False, returns newest by created_at for session or globally), _create_context_node (generates context:session:uuid8 node with status ACTIVE, closed=False, timestamps, turn_count=0), _close_context_node (sets status CLOSED, closed=True, records closure_reason and closed_at), _touch_context_node (updates updated_at timestamp, increments turn_count), _check_time_gap (parses updated_at ISO string and compares elapsed minutes), _check_topic_shift (extracts mentioned_sense_ids from last 5 vs prior-5 turns, computes Jaccard similarity). Thresholds: _DEFAULT_TIME_GAP_MINUTES=30.0, _DEFAULT_TOPIC_SHIFT_THRESHOLD=0.15, _TOPIC_COMPARISON_WINDOW=5. Side effects: Graph persistence save/query calls on node CRUD; logging at info/debug levels. ContextResolutionResult is frozen dataclass with no methods.
gotchas: _find_active_context falls back to max(active_contexts) globally if no session-specific context exists; this could return a context from a different session. _check_topic_shift returns False if fewer than 2*TOPIC_COMPARISON_WINDOW (10) turns exist in session, skipping shift detection on sparse conversations. _extract_senses is module-level helper; context node properties must have mentioned_sense_ids as list; no validation on sense_id format.
